## Claude Code

Commands, skills, and eligible agents are also registered natively, generated from the `.agents/` sources:
- `.claude/commands/` — one entry per `.agents/commands/*.md`, invoke directly with `/name`.
- `.claude/skills/` — one entry per `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md`, `user-invocable: false` so Claude loads them autonomously by description match, never as a typed `/name`.
- `.claude/agents/` — one entry per `.agents/agents/*.md` that declares `subagent: true` in its frontmatter (plus a `tools:` list). Currently: `code-reviewer`, `implementer`, `security-reviewer`, `test-engineer`. The rest of `.agents/agents/` stays persona-only, role-played inline by the orchestrating session within a pipeline (e.g. `add-domain`) rather than dispatched as an isolated subagent.

All three are generated by [`.agents/hooks/sync-claude-native.sh`](.agents/hooks/sync-claude-native.sh). Never hand-edit files under `.claude/commands/`, `.claude/skills/`, `.claude/agents/`, or this file — edit the `.agents/` source (including its `subagent`/`tools` frontmatter) and rerun the script.
